test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a row facing the north. S is sitting to the immediate left of Q.P is sitting to the immediate right of Q. U is sitting to the immediate right of P and immediate left of T. S and R are sitting at the ends of the line not necessarily in the same order. Who is sitting to the immediate right of T?
solution: Given: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a row facing the north. 1) S and R are sitting at the ends of the line not necessarily in the same order. 2) S is sitting to the immediate left of Q.
